subject.title: fix(config): reject invalid heartbeat activeHours without cadence

question: Should this PR intentionally make malformed `heartbeat.activeHours.start/end` values fail config validation even when `heartbeat.every` is omitted?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and matches the documented HH:MM contract, but stricter config validation can stop existing malformed configs during upgrade, so automation should not silently accept that merge risk.

options.title: Accept fail-fast invalid config
options.body: Merge once exact-head CI is green, treating previously accepted malformed active-hours values as invalid user config that must be corrected.

options.title: Add recovery guidance first
options.body: Ask for PR-body or docs guidance that tells users how to correct malformed active-hours values before merging.

options.title: Keep permissive runtime
options.body: Reject the stricter validation and leave malformed active-hours values permissive, which keeps the linked bug unresolved.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-fast invalid config
recommendation.body: Merge once exact-head CI is green, treating previously accepted malformed active-hours values as invalid user config that must be corrected.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently carried the current schema/runtime split and are the strongest routing signal for this config-validation merge-risk choice.
